Eligible students, parents, and educators in the US now have a few extra weeks to take advantage of Apple's 2026 Back to School promotion on select Mac and iPad models. Here's what you need to know.

Apple 2026 Back to School Promotion Extended to September 24

According to a discovery by MacRumors, Apple has updated the promotional period for its 2026 Back to School deal. Originally running from July 16 through August 27, the promotion now has an end date of September 24.

This year, in addition to standard education discounts offering reduced pricing on eligible Macs and iPads, eligible students who purchase a qualifying Mac or iPad can also receive an Apple Gift Card of up to $150.

Below is the official table from Apple showing the gift card amount included with each eligible Mac and iPad purchase:

Product Category Eligible Products Promotion Product Mac MacBook Pro $150 Apple Gift Card Mac MacBook Air $100 Apple Gift Card iPad iPad Air $100 Apple Gift Card iPad iPad Pro $100 Apple Gift Card

Per the terms and conditions of the "College Student Offer 2026":

Eligible participants in this promotion include faculty, staff, students, and parents (each, an "Eligible Purchaser"), as follows: K–12 – Employees of public or private K–12 institutions in the US, including homeschool teachers, are eligible. Additionally, currently serving elected or appointed school board members are eligible. Currently serving elected or appointed officers of a parent-teacher association (PTA or PTO) executive board are eligible. Higher Education – Faculty and staff teaching at a US higher education institution, as well as students enrolled in or accepted to a US higher education institution, are eligible. Higher Education Student Parents – Parents purchasing on behalf of their child, where that child is currently enrolled in or accepted to a US public or private higher education institution, are eligible. Individual purchases made through the Apple Store for Education are not intended for institutional purchasing or resale.

If you don't qualify, or you're seeing this after the promotion ends, you can still often find Mac and iPad discounts via Apple's official Amazon storefront that exceed Apple's standard education pricing.

You can also save up to 15% on a wide range of products through Apple's Certified Refurbished store.
